title: Beauty Discount Codes: LOOKFANTASTIC, Sephora | VoucherVault
description: Live beauty discount codes and free gifts from LOOKFANTASTIC, Sephora and Boots: codes on selected skincare, gift-with-purchase offers and free sample bags.
intro: Skincare, make-up, haircare and fragrance codes, plus the gift-with-purchase offers that beauty retailers run every week.

sections.h2: Getting the most from beauty offers
sections.html:
• Gift with purchase offers are added in the basket automatically while stocks last, so buy early in the offer.
  • Check whether a minimum spend is measured before or after discount (LOOKFANTASTIC says "after discount" on many of its gifts).
  • App-exclusive offers only work in the retailer's app.
